rv.q: Applauding the set, clapping when an actor enters the stage, and the obligatory standing ovation are among my biggest pet peeves on Broadway, but they all seem perfectly understandable when it comes to 'The Cottage'.
The play is a sensational, feminist twist on a classic British period drama that features knockout performances, melodramatic reveals, and some seriously outrageous one-liners
Moments like that make 'The Cottage' a Broadway funhouse.
Can you see some of the jokes coming a mile away with your eyes closed? Sure. But you'll still laugh.
The Cottage is definitely a fun time at the theatre and a good date night to unwind and forget about the world for a while.
The funny and surprise-filled comedy made its San Diego premiere Saturday at North Coast Repertory Theatre in Solana Beach.
